name: longform-batch-delivery
whatsNew: v11.1.0 adds unattended mode (M0.1): Chatbox has no auto-continue switch, but queued messages are sent automatically when the current reply finishes, so queueing ~20 "continue" messages (cap 20) before you sleep gives ~20 auto-resumed rounds; combined with M0 (never end the turn) that yields e.g. 20 x 6 x 1800 ~ 216k chars per night. Ships templates/queue_resume.txt, docs/unattended.zh.md / .en.md, and scripts/overnight_driver.py (a真 zero-human API loop outside the chat, BYOK).
